reagan.definition: n. 40th President of the United States (1911-2004)

reagan administration.translation: [网络] 里根政府；里根时代；雷根政府

reagan democrat.translation: [网络] 里根民主党人；民主党中的保守派

reaganesque.translation: a. (美国前总统)里根式的(属于或类似里根总统政策的)

reaganism.translation: n. 里根主义(指美国第四十任总统Ronald Reagan实行的政策), 对里根主义的信奉

reaganite.translation: n. (美国前总统)里根工作班子成员

reaganites.translation: (Reaganite 的复数) n. (美国前总统)里根工作班子成员

reaganomics.translation: [复]n.(由美国第四十任总统Ronald Reagan实行的包括强调供给理论等内容的)里根经济政策

reagent.definition: n. a chemical agent for use in chemical reactions
reagent.translation:
n. 试剂, 反应物
[化] 试剂

reagent bottle.translation:
[化] 试剂瓶
[医] 试剂瓶, 试药瓶

reagent grade.translation:
[化] 试剂级别
[医] 试药纯级[品]

reagentizing.translation: 用试剂处理, 用试剂加工

reagents.definition: n. a chemical agent for use in chemical reactions
reagents.translation: n. 反应物, 试剂( reagent的复数形式 )

reaggregated.translation: (reaggregate 的过去时) vt.使再聚集,使重新积聚

reaggregates.translation: (reaggregate 的复数) vt.使再聚集,使重新积聚

reaggregating.translation: (reaggregate 的现在分词) vt.使再聚集,使重新积聚

reagin.definition: n an immunoglobulin E that is formed as an antibody against allergens (such as pollen); attaches to cell membranes causing the release of histamine and other substances responsible for the local inflammation characteristic of an allergy
reagin.translation: n. [生]反应素,梅毒反应素,变应性反应素

reaginic antibody.translation: [化] 反应抗体; 反应素
